Charlotte —

Thanks for sending those. Two quick clarifications:
1) The W-8BEN-E you uploaded has the EIN entered as "US-EIN: XX-XXXXXXX" in the typed field; our OCR/validation wants the raw 9-digit number (e.g., 123456789). Can you re-save the PDF with only the digits in that field? That usually clears the portal check.
2) If you choose the video route we only need a short recorded session (10–15 mins) with the CFO on camera holding the gov ID and verbally confirming: company legal name, jurisdiction, 9-digit EIN, and that the person on camera is authorized to sign tax forms. The recording can be uploaded to the portal. This will be treated as interim evidence; we may request the notarized bank letter later for the vendor record.

Procurement (Marissa) is copied — Marissa, if the team provides the recording and the corrected W-8 we can proceed to create a provisional PO (PO will be flagged "tax-evidence provisional" and paid on standard terms).

Best,
Kimberly

- Video attestation: MP4 or MP3 containing video, 10–15 minutes, clearly shows ID and verbal confirmation of EIN and signing authority.
- Supporting doc: passport or government ID (photo matches video).

Please upload to: https://redwood.app/procurement/vendor-portal/evergreen-ai (select "Tax Evidence")
DocuSign alternative: https://app.docusign.com/send/ABC-123-PO-TAX (if you want to sign an alternate affidavit)

If you upload today, I will expedite and attempt to issue provisional PO within our EMEA/US scheduling window. If you need a formal purchase order number for internal approvals before the upload, let me know and I can issue a placeholder memo, but it will not be usable for payment.
